I am writing to express my profound self-pity for having mistakenly entrusted my dental health to a clinic so clearly devoid of professional experience. It is a regrettable waste of my time and resources.

1. Negligence in Basic Diagnostics
The lack of fundamental observational skills displayed by your staff is alarming. Despite my explicit report of sensitivity to sweets—a textbook symptom of dental caries—and visible discoloration, I was subjected to unnecessary X-rays. Forcing a patient to pay for imaging to confirm what should be a "Day One" clinical observation is not just redundant; it is predatory and incompetent.

2. Physical Mishandling and Lack of Technique
The procedure for a single cavity was handled with such clumsiness that it felt like an assault on my entire mouth. The dentist’s inability to manage their instruments resulted in them resting the heavy handpiece against my lower teeth, causing a pain. When corrected, the dentist simply shifted the weight to my upper teeth instead. Despite my full cooperation and positioning, the sheer lack of spatial awareness and dexterity made a simple filling feel like a traumatic, whole-mouth ordeal.

3. Systematic Operational Failure
Your reservation system is a total failure. For the second time in a row, I was forced to wait 45 minutes despite having a prior appointment. Given that I have only visited your clinic twice, you maintain a 100% failure rate regarding punctuality. This is not a "delay"; it is a blatant disrespect for your clients' time.

Terrible service. The staff provided excellent communication. They didn't read appointment notifications via LINE or other chat messages. The dentist and assistant were helpful, but the front desk staff were awful. They didn't call before or after the appointment, and when I spoke to them, they just said, "Sorry," without providing any updates or solutions. Anyone considering using their services should think carefully. I reported this to the head office, but there's been no update. I went for clear aligner treatment, so they needed to take impressions, but they asked me to pay beforehand even though the impressions weren't taken. The assistant said they hadn't received the patient chart. How exactly do they operate? The company seems large with many branches, but their back-end system is terrible. Are the front desk staff not doing their job? Think twice before considering this place. Will they take responsibility if the orthodontic treatment doesn't go according to plan? Even the counter works like this. This is very disappointing. The staff showed no coordination or follow-up at all. Appointment dates were sent via LINE but left unread, and messages in chat were also ignored. The dentist and dental assistant provided good service, but the front desk staff were extremely poor.

There was no reminder call before the appointment, and even on the appointment day there was no notification. When I raised the issue, they just said “sorry” without any attempt to fix or update anything. I even contacted the head office, but there has been no response or improvement.

I went there for clear aligners, which required taking dental impressions. However, the staff asked me to make a payment before even taking the impressions. Meanwhile, the dental assistant said they had not received my patient chart.

So how exactly are you managing your operations? The company looks large with many branches, but is the backend system really this poor? Is the front desk not doing their job?
